session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Double Bottom, Then Bear Channel'. Reading: bear leg from the open (06:45-07:10) set a 5955 floor that formed the first higher-low double bottom; a bull leg lifted to a 6005 wedge top; after the wedge top failed lower highs under the 5990 red line, a second higher-low double bottom at 5965 gave only a weak 5990 retest and the afternoon became a bear channel sliding under the EMA to the 5930 low before a weak bounce. trend_reversal_to_bear (morning bull leg reversed into the bear channel afternoon; the title's 'Then Bear Channel' phrasing describes the same shift). Axis plain 06:45-13:15, day 2025-06-05.
